Chat request with custom stop sequences that terminates generation at a stop token

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json('{"messages":[{"content":"List items until you see STOP","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-4","stop":["STOP","END"]}')
    result = await client.chat(req)
    print(result.choices)
    print(result.choices[0].finish_reason)

asyncio.run(main())
```
